_about: 生图提示词模板与词库。改这个文件就能调整指令，不用改代码。模板里的 {name} 是占位符，{name} 缺失不会报错，整个子句会被跳过。

templates.subject: Redraw the subject in the reference image as {subject}.
templates.technique_from_reference: Keep only the reference's rendering technique - brushwork, shading, palette, edge treatment - and discard its shapes and proportions: {style}.
templates.aspect: Canvas shape: aspect ratio close to {ratio}:1 (reference is {width}x{height}).

background: one plain solid colour, completely flat, no shadow, no vignette, no gradient, no props

style_library.illustration: hand-painted storybook illustration rendering, visible brush strokes, gouache-like opaque colour with soft shading, warm ochre-cream-burgundy palette taken from the reference, crisp clean silhouette, simplified decorative shapes, no photorealistic feather detail, no photographic texture
style_library.painterly-2d: soft painterly 2D rendering, smooth airbrushed shading, visible brush texture, muted warm palette, crisp clean silhouette, no black outline
style_library.flat-vector: flat 2D vector rendering, thick dark outlines, cel shading, hard colour blocks with no gradients, limited warm palette, no photographic texture
style_library.cartoon: hand-drawn cartoon rendering, clean outlines, soft cel shading, simplified shapes, flat fills
style_library.pixel: pixel art rendering, limited palette, hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no gradients
style_library.watercolour: watercolour rendering, soft pigment bleeds, visible paper texture, organic edges, no hard digital lines
style_library.3d-render: stylised 3D rendering, soft global illumination, rounded forms, clean surface shading

part_hints.head: the head and face plate only, blank surface, no eyes, no pupils, no beak, no nostril, no facial features - those are separate layers
part_hints.body: torso only, no head, no limbs
part_hints.wing: a single wing, isolated, side view
part_hints.foot: a single foot, isolated, side view
part_hints.beak: only the beak, isolated, side view
part_hints.eye: a single eye, isolated, front view

part_structure.head: the silhouette follows the new species, never the reference: no inherited ear tufts, facial disc, ringed eye sockets or neck ruff
part_structure.body: the torso silhouette follows the new species; do not inherit the reference's outline, proportions or feather layout
part_structure.wing: the wing outline follows the new species; do not inherit the reference's feather count or layout
part_structure.foot: the foot shape follows the new species; do not inherit the reference's toe count or claws
part_structure.beak: the beak shape follows the new species; do not inherit the reference's length or curvature
part_structure.eye: iris, pupil and lid shape follow the new species; do not inherit the reference's eye markings
part_structure.leaf: the leaf outline follows the new subject, not the reference
part_structure.wood: the branch outline follows the new subject, not the reference

default_structure: the outline follows the new subject, never the reference's silhouette

view_words.front: strictly front view, symmetrical, facing the viewer directly, both eyes visible at the same height, full face, not a profile
view_words.side: strict side profile, one eye visible, facing left
view_words.three-quarter: three-quarter view, facing slightly to the left

negative.baseline: text, watermark, signature, logo, frame, border, photograph, photorealistic, 3d render, depth of field, multiple characters, extra limbs, cropped, blurry, low quality

view.front: side profile, three-quarter view, profile, one eye visible, turned head
view.side: front view, symmetrical face, both eyes

negative.features_from_rig: eyes, eyeballs, pupils, iris, eyelashes, beak, nostrils, facial features, mouth, teeth
